newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 22.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHIN TIMES - Opposition Democratic Progressive Party opposes over-expansion of presidential powers
Prosecutors indict 12 people, including former Tang Eng Ironwork President Andrew Yen, on corruption charges
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Opposition Democratic Progressive Party supports a revised presidential system as future government administration
Labour insurance premium to be reduced by one percentage point
LIBERTY TIMES - President Lee Teng-hui calls on United States to support Taiwan in times of China's sabre rattling against the island
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Panama to sign free trade agreement with Taiwan
April export orders grow 5.91 pct year-on-year
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Labour insurance premium to be reduced by one percentage point
U.S. Federal Reserve not to raise interest rates
